title: Butter and Onion BBQ Sauce

items: A little less than 1 tsp garlic powder
A little less than 1 tsp chili powder

steps: Melt butter and sauté onion until soft and translucent.
Add remaining ingredients, bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Serve warm with barbecue.
